issue.title: [Bug][202405]: System cpu and memory usage check fails

failure.body:
### Issue Description

The current memory usage threshold is 60% and that is exceeded in our Arista 7800 devices when configured in a T2 topology. Hence we need to increase this threshold to let the tests pass.

This can be reproduced by running: `platform_tests/test_cpu_memory_usage.py::test_cpu_memory_usage::test_cpu_memory_usage`

### Results you see

```
Failed: system cpu and memory usage check fails
--------------------------------------------------
	 platform_tests 1
--------------------------------------------------
	 2024-12-11 <IPV6>: platform_tests/test_cpu_memory_usage.py::test_cpu_memory_usage::test_cpu_memory_usage[cmp227-4]
```

### Results you expected to see

We expect the test to pass
